_comment: Worked example, collision-checked in a raster. All dimension values are MEASURED body geometry, not model parameters - SLAB has ZERO named user parameters, so there is no parameter table to dimension from. 'ext' is the model's true bounding box, which is exactly what make_views.py crops each view to, so millimetres map to page position arithmetically. 'from'/'to' on dims are mm along the view's own axis from its lower-left corner; positive 'offset' places the dimension above/right of the view, negative below/left. NOTE the RIGHT view looks from +X with up +Z, so screen-right is -Y: its local x is (y_max - Y).
